name: 29680 · Simpsonville, SC
findings: ZIP 29680 (Simpsonville) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29680 (Simpsonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29680 (Simpsonville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
